# Comment fixtures

Real comment HTML, pulled from the archive. All three are NiallOTuama's own
words, so nothing here republishes another member's comments.

| File | Source | What it exercises |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `award_original.html` | comment 7034991 | an award being given: the marker image sits directly in the comment |
| `quote_reply.html` | comment 7035001 | quotes the award **and** deliberately gives it a third time, so it must still match after the quote is stripped |
| `quote_only.html` | derived from 7035001 | its real quote block with the third award removed — a reply that merely quotes an award and must **not** match |

The live example of the pure-quote case is
<https://www.dpchallenge.com/image.php?IMAGE_ID=1160121>, where the awarder
quotes their own earlier award two days later. It is not committed here because
those are another member's words.
